en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 4. And from the previous chain from Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah from his father from al-Qasim b. ’Urwa from Abdillah b. Bukayr from Zurarah b. A’yan from Abi Ja’far and Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
A person who has even an iota of pride in his heart will not enter Paradise.”
